tools.name: search_predictions
tools.description: Find Elon Musk predictions by keywords, such as a product, event or phrase he used (for example 'robotaxi', 'Mars 2024', 'Starship orbit', 'Optimus'). Use this when the user names a specific promise or subject. Returns up to 'limit' best matches, each with its claim_id, title, verdict, the date he f

tools.name: get_prediction
tools.description: Get the full record of one Elon Musk prediction: every time he said it (date, exact quote, source link, and whether it was the first statement, a restatement or a moved deadline), the first and current deadline, the verdict with a plain explanation of how it was graded, and the twoweeks.lol page URL

tools.name: list_predictions
tools.description: List Elon Musk predictions filtered by company, topic and/or verdict, with a count of every verdict in that group. Use this for track-record questions ('how many Tesla deadlines did he miss?', 'what SpaceX promises are still open?', 'which deadlines moved the most?') rather than for one named promis
